youtube.title: Why Pigeons Bob Their Heads When They Walk 🐦 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
A pigeon's head thrusts forward and then holds still while its body catches up. Pigeon eyes have limited movement in their sockets, so the head acts as the camera stabilizer. A moving head blurs the picture, so the bird holds it still for a few moments to see clearly. This is called the optokinetic response.
